instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\slot_plate.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Create a Pocket or iMachining 2D toolpath for the centered 40 x 8 slot in C:\Users\User\Desktop\slot_plate.step. Machine the slot through to Z=0.000 mm with T1 at S8500 rpm and F500 mm/min. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill, S8500 rpm, F500 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-02.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
